info.name: Dream Tour Website API
info.description:
Dream Travel and Tours website API, checked against registered Laravel routes.

Import DreamTour.postman_environment.json and select it. Default backend: http://127.0.0.1:8001; API: http://127.0.0.1:8001/api. Run Splash / Get Splash to populate lookup IDs. Use Authentication / Register or Login with your customer credentials; the Sanctum token is saved automatically. API requests disable cookie usage to keep customer and staff identities separate.

Dream Tour services includes public content, rental catalog, seven service inquiry types and staff operations. Staff authentication uses Get session and CSRF token followed by Existing workspace login, with separate staff credentials. Postman retains cookies and the rotated CSRF token.

Select individual requests for the desired workflow. This collection is not an ordered end-to-end test: write requests create or modify records. Supply existing IDs, published content and applicable dates. Public quotations require public_quote_token from an enabled, unexpired quote link. See docs/POSTMAN.md.
